records.text: CERN was established in 1954 to research particle physics.
records.speaker: Mark (Candace show producer; surname unverified)

appearances.snippet: And I just want to preface by saying I am not a particle physicist. So I'm just I just use particle physics recreationally. I'm a high school dropout. This is all on my own. But CERN was basically established in 1954 to research particle physics.

verification.notes: CERN's official history states that the organization began in 1954 and that fundamental physics has been its core business; CERN describes its main research area as particle physics.

sources.title: Our History — CERN
sources.relevance: Official CERN history confirms its 1954 establishment and fundamental/particle-physics research mission.

records.text: CERN's Large Hadron Collider is a 17-mile tunnel near Geneva, reaches roughly 600 feet underground in places, and collides subatomic particles at high speed.
records.speaker: Mark (Candace show producer; surname unverified)

appearances.snippet: and peter higgs i believe and so the search was on to find this particle and so that's why cern created the large hadron collider which is based in geneva switzerland and is a 17 mile tunnel underground up to 600 feet underground in some places where they shoot particles at subatomic particles at each other at a very high speed to try and break them apart to see what they're found what they're composed of

verification.notes: CERN describes the LHC as a 27-kilometre ring near Geneva where high-energy beams travel near light speed and collide. Its official guide gives tunnel depths of 50 to 175 metres, making the maximum about 574 feet and the statement's rough 600-foot figure reasonable.

sources.title: The Large Hadron Collider — CERN
sources.relevance: Official CERN page confirms the 27-km ring, Geneva-area location, high-speed beams, and collisions.

sources.title: LHC the guide — CERN
sources.relevance: Official CERN guide gives the tunnel depth range as 50 to 175 metres, approximately 574 feet at maximum.

records.text: In 2012, CERN observed a reaction consistent with the Higgs boson theorized in 1964.
records.speaker: Mark (Candace show producer; surname unverified)

appearances.snippet: and peter higgs i believe and so the search was on to find this particle and so that's why cern created the large hadron collider which is based in geneva switzerland and is a 17 mile tunnel underground up to 600 feet underground in some places where they shoot particles at subatomic particles at each other at a very high speed to try and break them apart to see what they're found what they're composed of and so in 2012 they observed a reaction reaction that's consistent with this particle that was theorized back in 1964 that they were calling some people were calling it the god particle

verification.notes: CERN states that ATLAS and CMS reached the five-sigma discovery threshold on 4 July 2012 and identified a new particle consistent with the long-sought Higgs boson proposed decades earlier. 'Observed a reaction' is imprecise, but the factual substance is correct.

sources.title: How did we discover the Higgs boson? — CERN
sources.relevance: Official CERN explanation confirms the 2012 discovery of a particle consistent with the Higgs boson.

records.text: An article read during the episode reported that a satanic human-sacrifice scene had been staged on CERN's Large Hadron Collider grounds.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: And I'm just going to read you this article verbatim because otherwise you won't believe me. Okay, this took place. CERN discovers satanic human sacrifice taking place. It can place at the Large Hadron Collider grounds, okay? A satanic human sacrifice, it reads, has been staged on the grounds of the European Organization for Nuclear Research, the home of the Large Hadron Collider.

verification.notes: Contemporaneous reporting described a video filmed on CERN's Geneva campus that depicted a staged or mock occult human-sacrifice scene. The statement accurately characterizes what the article reported; it does not assert that a real sacrifice occurred.

sources.title: Fake human sacrifice filmed at Cern, with pranking scientists suspected
sources.relevance: Contemporaneous report confirms an article described the staged scene on CERN's campus.

records.text: The staged ritual video was a prank, and the participants had taken their sense of humor too far.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #2 (Ep BKcOm32ZEGk)

appearances.snippet: So when they got caught with this, I want you to know they come out and they say. Oh, that was a prank. I'm sorry. It's a massive statute, as you're about to see. You're telling us that the leading scientists in the world decided to meet by the cloak of night to do a prank and someone at the facility gave a statement and said they were the PR guy said they were taking their sense of humor too far.

verification.notes: CERN's contemporaneous statement characterized the video as a spoof or prank and said authorized scientific users had let their humor go too far. Reporting also states the stabbing was staged.

records.text: CERN's stated objective was to recreate the Big Bang.
records.speaker: Rob Skiba

appearances.snippet: Look up CERN. Uh it's a very interesting facility. Just look at this thing. The thing's huge. It's a the Hadron Super Super Collider they're trying to their stated objective is to recreate the Big Bang

verification.notes: Transcript reviewed. CERN officially says the LHC recreates conditions similar to those just after the Big Bang. That supports the substance, but not the literal wording that CERN attempts to recreate the Big Bang itself.

sources.title: Heavy ions and quark-gluon plasma — CERN
sources.relevance: CERN says collisions recreate conditions similar to those just after the Big Bang.

records.text: CERN placed a statue of the Hindu god Shiva outside its entrance.
records.speaker: Rob Skiba

appearances.snippet: Well, it's interesting that all these scientists and people working over there on CERN decide to put the religious statue of the Hindu god Shiva outside the front door.

verification.notes: Transcript reviewed. CERN official material confirms that India gifted CERN a two-metre Shiva Nataraja statue and that it was unveiled on CERN grounds. The statement is accurate in substance.

sources.title: CERN Director General Outlines Seven-point Strategy for European Laboratory
sources.relevance: Official CERN record confirms India gifted and unveiled the Shiva Nataraja statue.

records.text: A video showed people at CERN dressed in robes staging a stabbing ritual, and CERN offered no answer beyond calling it a joke.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: I showed you guys the video of what they were doing, this ritual. These are quote-unquote scientists that are dressed up in robes stabbing someone and they never gave an answer for this. Somebody caught them, recorded this, and they're like, oh, that was a joke. No further questions, no further answers.

verification.notes: Transcript reviewed. A video filmed on CERN premises did depict robed figures staging a stabbing. CERN called it a fictional prank, said it was unauthorized, and opened an internal investigation, so the video description is true but the claim that CERN offered no response beyond calling it a joke is incomplete.

sources.title: Fake human sacrifice filmed at CERN, with pranking scientists suspected — The Guardian
sources.relevance: Confirms the staged video and CERN unauthorized-prank response and investigation.

records.text: The world's leading nuclear physicists were caught cloaked before a statue of Shiva, stabbing a woman in an occult ceremony for CERN.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: And on the matter of science, even when it's in our faces, like when the world's leading nuclear physicists are caught. ... cloaked before a statue of Shiva stabbing a woman in an occult ceremony for CERN, well, you guys, that's just science.

verification.notes: Context reviewed at 5:16. A staged mock-sacrifice video was filmed without authorization at CERN near the Shiva statue, but reporting identifies it as a prank/mock ritual and does not establish that the participants were the world's leading nuclear physicists or that an actual stabbing/occult ceremony occurred.

sources.title: CERN looks into mock human sacrifice video - DW
sources.relevance: Reports CERN described the staged occult-looking scene as a mock human-sacrifice prank, not a real ceremony by leading physicists.
